Container.Name: book_sorter
Container.Overview: Scanner/indexer for a large game-book collection. Walks a directory tree, indexes every file into an embedded Postgres database, and catalogs each book locally (title, publisher, authors, game line and system, catalog number, ISBN incl. cover barcode, year, edition, printing), OCRs image-only PDFs, cleans scanned covers for thumbnails with perceptual hashes, then verifies with a self-hosted AI and — last resort — DriveThruRPG / Open Library / Google Books / RPGGeek. Found data is never overwritten by online sources. Includes a web dashboard with live progress and a searchable table, and a Library layout page that files sorted, renamed books into the sorted destination (verified copy, then the original is removed). book_sorter never deletes the files: a file that should be removed is moved to _to_delete.
Container.Description: Game-book collection indexer (embedded Postgres + FastAPI dashboard). Single container; database and thumbnails persist on appdata; sorted books go to the sorted destination. Never deletes the files.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the dashboard

Config.Name: Collection
Config.Description: The game-book collection to index. Read-write so the Library layout can remove a book's original once its verified copy is in the sorted destination. book_sorter never deletes the files.

Config.Name: sorted_destination
Config.Description: Where the Library layout files sorted and renamed books (Books/, Fiction/, Magazines/, Comics/). /mnt/user0 writes straight to the array, not the cache pool. Each book is copied here, checked against the original (size and hash), then the original is removed from the collection.

Config.Name: Postgres data
Config.Description: Embedded Postgres data dir (persist on appdata)

Config.Name: Work dir (scratch/thumbs/ocr)
Config.Description: Scratch, thumbnails and OCR staging live here on a data pool, kept OFF the small docker SSD. Subdirs: tmp/ thumbs/ ocr/.

Config.Name: Temp dir (TMPDIR)
Config.Description: OCR scratch (ocrmypdf.io.*) is written here — on the work pool, never the docker SSD. Cleaned on startup.

Config.Name: Thumbnail dir
Config.Description: First-page thumbnail store (JPEG), on the work pool.

Config.Name: OCR staging dir
Config.Description: Transient OCR output staging, on the work pool.

Config.Name: OCR languages
Config.Description: Tesseract languages (installed: eng deu fra spa por ita pol rus)

Config.Name: OCR workers (default)
Config.Description: Default concurrent OCR tasks (also adjustable per-run in the dashboard)

Config.Name: OCR during scan
Config.Description: Queue + OCR image-only PDFs/djvu automatically while scanning

Config.Name: Documents only
Config.Description: Index only document types; skip images/audio/video/3D-print/archives

Config.Name: Scan on start
Config.Description: Begin a catalog scan automatically when the container starts. Off: every restart or update would re-walk the whole collection; start a scan from the Dashboard when files changed.

Config.Name: Scan workers
Config.Description: Concurrent extraction workers

Config.Name: Hash all types
Config.Description: Also MD5 non-target files (videos/images/archives). Heavy I/O; off by default.

Config.Name: Force rescan
Config.Description: Re-extract every file even if unchanged

Config.Name: Barcode dir
Config.Description: Clean barcode crops (PNG), on the work pool.

Config.Name: Clean scanned covers
Config.Description: Dust removal / border trim / levels on SCANNED covers before thumbnailing. Born-digital covers are never touched.

Config.Name: Ollama URL (local AI verification)
Config.Description: Self-hosted Ollama that checks found fields against each book's credits pages, e.g. http://10.47.40.43:11434. Empty = skip the AI stage.

Config.Name: Ollama model
Config.Description: Model used for verification (JSON output).

Config.Name: Ollama context size
Config.Description: Context (tokens) sent with every AI request. Must equal the context the Ollama server keeps the model loaded at, or every request forces a full model reload. Tower03: 18432.

Config.Name: Ollama keep-alive
Config.Description: How long Ollama keeps the model loaded after a request: -1 = forever (pinned). Never 0 (unloads after every book).

Config.Name: Ollama timeout (s)
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for one AI answer, including time queued behind other apps on a shared Ollama. A timeout is retried on the next pass.

Config.Name: OCR vision model URL
Config.Description: Ollama with a vision model that reads the key pages of books the OCR program cannot process. Empty = off.

Config.Name: OCR vision model
Config.Description: Vision model for that OCR fallback: an OCR model (GLM-OCR) or an instruct, non-thinking vision model.

Config.Name: Publisher vision URL
Config.Description: Ollama with a reasoning vision model that reads a book's cover to name a publisher the online check could not find. Empty = the Publisher (vision) stage is off.

Config.Name: Publisher vision model
Config.Description: A reasoning vision model (reads the logo AND the indicia), e.g. qwen3-vl:8b. Not an OCR-only model.

Config.Name: Publisher validate URL (OmniRoute)
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway that resolves a SUGGESTED publisher the reference DB could not confirm. John's OmniRoute: http://10.47.40.121:20128/v1. Empty = the Publisher (validate) stage is off.

Config.Name: Publisher validate API key
Config.Description: OmniRoute API key (Bearer) from its dashboard (REQUIRE_API_KEY=true). Empty = no auth header sent.

Config.Name: Publisher validate model
Config.Description: Model the gateway should use to validate publisher names (grounded). Gemini worked well on this backlog.

Config.Name: DriveThruRPG API key
Config.Description: Your DriveThruRPG library API key (read-only, verification only). Empty = skip.

Config.Name: Google Books API key
Config.Description: Google Books API key (free; console.cloud.google.com, enable the Books API, restrict the key to it). Used for ISBN and title lookups. Empty = Google Books is skipped.

Config.Name: RPGGeek (BGG) app token
Config.Description: BoardGameGeek XML API application token (boardgamegeek.com/applications). Empty = skip. Non-commercial use; data credited to BoardGameGeek.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Logging level

Config.Name: cloudfiles (unified mount)
Config.Description: Single parent mount for the whole cloudfiles share. With DATA_ROOT and SORTED_ROOT pointing inside it, the collection and the sorted destination are on ONE filesystem, so a Library-layout move is an instant atomic os.rename instead of a cross-mount verified copy. (The separate /data and /sorted mounts can be removed once everything uses this.)

Config.Name: Collection root (DATA_ROOT)
Config.Description: Collection root. Point inside the unified cloudfiles mount (/cloudfiles/games) so moves are instant renames; leave as /data for the legacy two-mount layout.

Config.Name: Sorted root (SORTED_ROOT)
Config.Description: Sorted destination. Point inside the unified cloudfiles mount (/cloudfiles/sorted), the same filesystem as DATA_ROOT, so moves are instant renames; leave as /sorted for the legacy two-mount layout.
